raw_segments.text: Not higher that hill, nor wider looking round, whereon, for different cause, the tempter
set our second Adam in the wilderness, to show him all earth's kingdoms and their glory.
His eye might their command were ever stood city of old or modern fame, the seat of mightiest
empire, from the destined walls of Cambalu, seat of Cadian Can, and Samarchand by Oxus,
Temyr's throne, to Paquin of Cenaean kings, and thence to Agra and Laher of Great Mogul
down to the Golden Caresonese, or where the Persian in Ekbatin sat, or since in Hispahan,
or where the Russian Kaesar in Moscow, or the Sultan in Bizance, Turkestan-born.
Nor could his eye not ken the empire of Negus to his utmost port Urkoko, and the less meritim
kings Mombaza, and Quilloa, and Meland, and Sofalah, thought ofer to the realm of Congo
